messages:
Maria: Heads-up — spun up a pilot using stochastic cohort gating for v2.2-int4 on longdoc traffic. Looking for quick sanity checks before we widen slices.
Kai: Nice. What's the initial traffic fraction? Any slice definitions?
Maria: 0.5% global, +2% to longdoc cohort only (seqlen>2k). Gate rule: if relative MRR drop >2% OR hallucination-rate delta >0.8pt we auto-fallback. Also latency p99 must stay under 320ms.
Devin: Where are we measuring hallucination-rate? The eval harness or live prod signal?
Sarah: Both — we have a lightweight prod detector (semantic-contradiction heuristic) + offline eval on 5k labeled longdocs.
Kai: So fallback is automatic? Who gets paged?
Maria: Yes automatic fallback to v2.1-int8 variant; notifications to #eng-oncall + @Maria and @Devin. deploy-bot will post action.
Lee: Any A/B early numbers?
Maria: After ~3k requests: MRR -0.3% (within noise), hallucination delta +0.9pt on the labeled slice (crossed threshold), but prod detector still low (~+0.2).
Devin: Interesting divergence. Could be eval labeling sensitivity. Do we have sample transcripts?
Sarah: Pasted a few below:
```text
Q: Summarize contract terms.
Model v2.2: added assertion 'no liability' — wrong.
v2.1: correct.
```
Kai: If eval sees +0.9pt but prod detector 0.2, maybe the eval set is biased. I'd prefer hold and increase sample size before fallback.
Maria: Agreed. I bumped cohort to 1% and started a shadow-run to collect more prod-labeled ground truth. Also toggled backoff: require 2 consecutive windows (10k reqs each) to trigger auto-fallback.
Devin: Sounds good. Let's keep the original thresholds but require hysteresis. Update runbook?
Maria: Updated runbook and pinned config. deploy-bot: apply gate config:
```json
{
  "cohort": "longdoc",
  "fraction": 0.01,
  "thresholds": {
    "mrr_drop_pct": 2.0,
    "halluc_pt": 0.8
  },
  "hysteresis_windows": 2
}
```
deploy-bot: gate config applied to staging -> canary pool. Notified #eng-ml.
Sarah: Can we add a secondary metric: structured-output-fidelity score, to reduce false positives?
Maria: Yes adding that. Will rerun with composite comparator (weighted: 0.6 hallucination, 0.4 fidelity).
Lee: Thanks — keep us posted. Ping me if auto-fallback fires.
